_note: Canonical source of truth for all hard commodity facts. Every duty factor, lot size, tax note, and structural constant used anywhere in this codebase must match what is here. market-structure.json, analyst-kb.json, and intelligence-engine.js must never contradict this file. Updated manually when world facts change; CI script check-commodity-constants.mjs validates consistency with contract-specs.json.

crude.importDutyNote: Includes import duty differential on crude oil imports. Used in hawk-scan import parity formula: WTI ($/bbl) × USD/INR ÷ 159 × 1.025 = ₹/litre.
crude.taxTreatment: Non-speculative business income (CTT 0.01% on sell side). STCG does not apply to MCX commodity futures.

opec.note: Angola exited OPEC in January 2024, reducing member count from 13 to 12. Total OPEC+ = 12 OPEC members + Russia + allied non-OPEC producers = 23 nations.

gold.importDutyNote: Post-July 2024 budget. Previously 12.5% BCD + 3% AIDC = ~15.5% (pre-2024). Canonical source: app/learn/comex-vs-mcx-gold and data/analyst-kb.json.
gold.taxTreatment: MCX gold futures: non-speculative business income at slab rate (CTT 0.01% on sell side). STCG does not apply to MCX commodity futures. Note: physical gold and gold ETF have different tax treatment — see market-structure.json taxNote for those.

silver.importDutyNote: ~10% effective duty on silver imports. Verify if July 2024 budget changed silver duty (gold was cut from 12.5% to 6% BCD; silver duty may differ).
silver.taxTreatment: Non-speculative business income (CTT 0.01% on sell side). STCG does not apply to MCX commodity futures.
